scoutSummary: Phase 04 audit confirmed the legacy HotSwap=400 dispatch and in-kernel orchestrator remain live, while the CLI already uses Supervisor IPC. Removing the variant must preserve bit 32 through HotSwapReady and Snapshot, delete only kernel policy helpers, and prove 400 becomes Unknown. The pre-build baseline passed API 16/16, hotswap 15/15, and launch-profile 1/1; gen_disk has a pre-existing PowerShell Zig-script resolution failure and real MMC proof remains host-gated.
